title: Padded Neighbor Characterization
statement: Let $n,D\in\mathbb{N}$, let $r$ be a relation on $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $u,v\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be distinct. For every $i\in\{0,\ldots,D-1\}$, the padded neighbor of $u$ at index $i$ equals $v$ if and only if $i=v$ and $r(u,v)$ holds.
